teacher: pinned YaneuraOu KP256 6.03 WASM, same fixed pretrained weights as v0.8/v0.9

data.moveChoice: fixed per-game PRNG among top 3 within 180cp of best; use best at mate
data.labels: root score and each candidate child side-to-move score; conventional cp only; preserve game/rank/phase/PV; exclude checked feature positions when fitting quiet evaluator
data.dedup: exact position ignoring move counter and left-right mirror canonical key; later split takes priority; split games before generation

training.stage1: direct neural head fitting teacher search targets; frozen NNUE feature transformer and first hidden layer, train last hidden32 and output1, 1089 weights/biases
training.stage2: inspect validation search degradation/errors; reconstruct using anchoring to base, robust/squashed loss, conservative parameter interpolation; choose solely on validation
training.loss: teacher-score regression, not game win-probability calibration
training.numpy: NumPy manual backprop + Adam + quantization-aware export to compatible integer NNUE format

selection.static: validation-only metrics and phase/tactical diagnostics; save checkpoints
selection.search: validation roots with fixed-node budget and teacher depth10 candidate-union ranking; consider regression tail, not only mean static error
selection.test: do not compute candidate test metrics until final candidate hash frozen

evaluation.matchBudget: fixed 12000 nodes per move, cap200, 16 holdout openings x colors swapped; both engines same search code; legal fallback if first iteration unavailable
evaluation.timing: timed searches sequential after generation and training, rotation of variant order; node-budget matches may use parallel workers
evaluation.baseline: original NNUE weights in v0.9 search
evaluation.controls: full/incremental NNUE equality; Python/C++ inference parity; malformed model checks; existing rules tests

scope: substantially larger local research experiment, not million-position professional training; no Elo or independent teacher claim
